description: This file contains a utility function 'inferColumns' used for generating column configurations for a DataTable component based on the provided data rows and an allowlist. It ensures that only relevant fields are included and formats date fields for display.

methods.name: inferColumns(rows = [], allowlist = [], options = {})
methods.description: Generates an array of column definitions for a DataTable by intersecting data fields with an allowlist and applying specific formatting for date fields.
